title: Options Max Pain & Gamma Exposure (GEX) Levels Input

symbols.title: Symbols
symbols.description: US stock, ETF or index tickers. Indexes work bare (SPX, NDX, RUT, VIX).

maxDaysToExpiry.title: Max days to expiry
maxDaysToExpiry.description: Only include expiries within this many days. 0 = today's (0DTE) only.

maxExpiries.title: Max expiries
maxExpiries.description: Nearest N expiries included in the calculation.

includeExpiryRows.title: One row per expiry
includeExpiryRows.description: Add a row per expiry next to the all-expiries row for each symbol.

strikeRangePercent.title: Strike range for walls (%)
strikeRangePercent.description: Call/put walls and top GEX strikes are picked within this distance of the current price.

topStrikes.title: Top GEX strikes
topStrikes.description: How many strikes to list in topGexStrikes.
